title: Two Moves, No More
setup: Your king on e2 is boxed in by Black's queen, rook and bishop, and Black's king has crept to c1.
hint: You cannot both defend and attack. Work out how many checks you have and whether they run out.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qd2+}} forces {{Kb1}}, and {{Rf1#}} mates along the first rank. There was never a defensive move worth playing — the position was decided by whose attack was one tempo shorter.
